visualDescription.sceneDescriptionEn: A black and white engraving depicting two men in a dense forest setting by a riverbank. One man stands with his arms crossed, wearing fringed buckskin clothing and a fur cap. The other man is seated on a rock, wearing traditional indigenous-style clothing with a feathered headpiece, holding a long rifle. The background features thick trees and foliage.
